Summary of websites posted to 'general' channel:

1. www.informations.com: This website appears to discuss job market news, specifically mentioning that the latest job report showed unemployment edging down to 7.2%, bringing a mix of relief and concern.

2. www.restaurant-zurich.com: This website promotes Zurich Restaurant, described as a cozy, alpine-inspired eatery specializing in authentic Swiss cuisine. Features include traditional dishes like cheese fondue, rösti, and chocolate fondue; warm wooden interiors with Swiss memorabilia; panoramic city views; and staff in traditional Swiss attire.

Both websites seem to focus on distinct topics - one on current employment data and the other on a dining experience with Swiss thematic elements.
